annotations.title: Make a form link for people without an account

description: Makes the link that lets anyone who has it add a row to the track through its form (volunteers logging hours, guests signing up), with a bot check. Ask the person first and tell them who they plan to give it to: anyone with the link can add rows. Made once: asking again gives the same link. The person turns it off or replaces it in the app.
name: share_form
title: Make a form link for people without an account
